name: Harissa Chickpeas with Quinoa, Courgette & Lemon Tahini
steps: Cook quinoa in 160ml salted water for 12 min. Remove from heat and rest 2 min with the lid on.
Halve courgette lengthways and slice into half-moons. Mince garlic.
Heat a griddle or frying pan until very hot. Char courgette 2–3 min per side. Set aside.
In the same pan, heat oil and fry chickpeas with harissa and garlic for 4–5 min until slightly crispy.
Whisk tahini with lemon juice, 2 tbsp water and a pinch of salt until smooth.
Serve quinoa topped with harissa chickpeas, charred courgette, a drizzle of lemon tahini and fresh coriander.
